description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, as measured by recall and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” and has a linear scale, ranging from “Full model (ours)” to “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”, with tick labels at each variant. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” and has a linear scale, ranging from 56 to 66, with tick labels at intervals of 2. A blue line with circular markers represents Recall, starting at 65.78 at “Full model (ours)” and decreasing to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A brown line with triangular markers represents F1-score, beginning at 65.44 at “Full model (ours)” and ending at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A grey line with diamond markers represents the F1-score, starting at 65.45 at “Full model (ours)” and decreasing to 59.17 at “w/o Attention”, then increasing to 64.06 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
